name: secure_static_website_deployment
short_description: Deploy static website securely to S3 with CloudFront OAC, proper security settings, and custom domain support
description: Secure greenfield deployment using S3 with private access, CloudFront with Origin Access Control, SSL certificate with validation, and comprehensive error handling. Creates everything from scratch including S3 bucket, CloudFront distribution, SSL certificate, and Route53 configuration.

steps.name: create_s3_bucket
steps.description: Create S3 bucket for private hosting. Use REST API endpoint, not website hosting, for better security with CloudFront OAC. Generate unique bucket name with random suffix.

tool_parameter_hints.error_handling: If bucket exists, check if we own it before proceeding
tool_parameter_hints.website_name: Use provided website name or derive from directory name
tool_parameter_hints.random_suffix: Generate random suffix to ensure bucket uniqueness

steps.name: block_public_access
steps.description: Enable S3 Block Public Access settings for security. Keep bucket private - CloudFront OAC will provide controlled access.

tool_parameter_hints.bucket_name: Use bucket name from previous step

steps.name: upload_website_files
steps.description: Upload website files to private S3 bucket. Set appropriate content types and caching headers. Exclude development files and directories.

tool_parameter_hints.source_directory: Current directory or specified build output directory

steps.name: create_origin_access_control
steps.description: Create CloudFront Origin Access Control for secure S3 access. This replaces the deprecated Origin Access Identity and provides better security.

steps.name: request_ssl_certificate
steps.description: Request SSL certificate via ACM for custom domain if provided. Certificate must be in us-east-1 for CloudFront. Include both apex and www subdomain.

tool_parameter_hints.command: aws acm request-certificate --domain-name ${custom_domain} --subject-alternative-names www.${custom_domain} --validation-method DNS --region us-east-1
tool_parameter_hints.conditional: Only execute if custom domain is provided
tool_parameter_hints.custom_domain: Custom domain name if provided by user

steps.name: get_certificate_validation_records
steps.description: Get DNS validation records for SSL certificate. These need to be added to Route53 for certificate validation.

tool_parameter_hints.conditional: Only execute if custom domain is provided
tool_parameter_hints.output: Extract DNS validation records for Route53 setup
tool_parameter_hints.certificate_arn: Use certificate ARN from previous step

steps.name: setup_route53_validation
steps.description: Add DNS validation records to Route53 for SSL certificate validation. Create hosted zone if it doesn't exist.

tool_parameter_hints.conditional: Only execute if custom domain is provided
tool_parameter_hints.prerequisite: Find or create hosted zone for domain
tool_parameter_hints.hosted_zone_id: Find hosted zone ID for the domain

steps.name: wait_for_certificate_validation
steps.description: Wait for SSL certificate to be validated and issued. This can take several minutes depending on DNS propagation.

tool_parameter_hints.conditional: Only execute if custom domain is provided
tool_parameter_hints.certificate_arn: Use certificate ARN from request step

steps.name: create_cloudfront_distribution
steps.description: Create CloudFront distribution with Origin Access Control, proper caching, and security headers. Use S3 REST endpoint, not website endpoint.

tool_parameter_hints.certificate_arn: Use from SSL certificate step if custom domain provided
tool_parameter_hints.aliases: Include custom domain and www subdomain if provided

steps.name: update_s3_bucket_policy
steps.description: Create bucket policy that allows CloudFront OAC to access S3 objects. This is more secure than public bucket access.

tool_parameter_hints.policy_content: Allow GetObject for CloudFront OAC only, deny direct public access
tool_parameter_hints.distribution_arn: Use CloudFront distribution ARN from previous step

steps.name: create_route53_alias
steps.description: Create Route53 A record pointing custom domain to CloudFront distribution using alias record for better performance.

tool_parameter_hints.conditional: Only execute if custom domain is provided
tool_parameter_hints.record_type: A record with alias to CloudFront distribution
tool_parameter_hints.distribution_domain: Use CloudFront distribution domain from previous step

steps.name: setup_error_pages
steps.description: Configure custom error pages in CloudFront for better user experience. Handle 404s and other errors gracefully, especially for SPAs.

tool_parameter_hints.distribution_id: Use distribution ID from create step

steps.name: verify_deployment
steps.description: Verify deployment by testing all URLs and checking security headers. Ensure S3 bucket is not directly accessible and all security measures are working.

tool_parameter_hints.command: Test CloudFront URL, custom domain, and verify S3 security
tool_parameter_hints.tests: Test CloudFront URL returns 200, verify S3 bucket returns 403 when accessed directly, check security headers
tool_parameter_hints.cloudfront_domain: Use distribution domain from create step

steps.name: output_deployment_summary
steps.description: Provide comprehensive deployment summary with all URLs, security verification, and next steps including DNS propagation times and maintenance recommendations.

tool_parameter_hints.outputs: Display CloudFront URL, custom domain URL (if configured), security status, SSL status, and next steps
tool_parameter_hints.security_status: Confirm S3 bucket private and CloudFront OAC enabled
tool_parameter_hints.ssl_status: Confirm SSL certificate validated and applied
tool_parameter_hints.next_steps: DNS propagation times, CI/CD setup recommendations, CloudWatch monitoring guidance
